selection: ascending dataset indices with nonempty next_items; first 640; one np.random.choice(targets) per source in order
id_mapping: item_ids.json is dense [0..N-1]; dataset row IDs equal item IDs; SeqBatch.ids and ids_fut preserve these row indices
input_identity_caveat: Hashes are post-hoc only; no pre-run data hashes were captured, so they do not prove historical byte identity. IDs are conditional on current configured input bytes matching those used by the sole MVG run.
device_caveat: This CPU-only reconstruction did not query the device. Current source requests logical cuda:0; raw MVG output did not print a device string or physical GPU identity.
